allow:
Bash(/tmp/add_env_to_vercel.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

PROJECT_ID="prj_I5YFj3aEboXpkYuWNzTVvHUA2zgo"
ORG_ID="team_s2FgQ8UF9GdocGF9k83bLdsc"

# Get the vercel token
VERCEL_TOKEN=$\(cat ~/.vercel/auth.json 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"token":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4\)

if [ -z "$VERCEL_TOKEN" ]; then
  echo "Token not found, trying environment variable..."
  VERCEL_TOKEN="${VERCEL_TOKEN}"
fi

if [ -z "$VERCEL_TOKEN" ]; then
  echo "Cannot find Vercel auth token. Will use CLI instead."
  echo "Run these commands manually:"
  echo "vercel env add RESEND_API_KEY"
  echo "vercel env add SENTRY_DSN"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Token found: ${VERCEL_TOKEN:0:20}..."

# Add env vars using curl to Vercel API
add_env_var\(\) {
  local key=$1
  local value=$2
  
  echo "Adding $key to Vercel..."
  curl -X POST "https://api.vercel.com/v10/projects/$PROJECT_ID/env" \\
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $VERCEL_TOKEN" \\
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
    -d "{
      \\"key\\": \\"$key\\",
      \\"value\\": \\"$value\\",
      \\"target\\": [\\"production\\"]
    }" \\
    -s | grep -o '"key":"[^"]*' | head -1
}

# Add the variables
add_env_var "RESEND_API_KEY" "re_7yNA7T4t_E7xy7GTYVwfMN3VXUg1bvNHj"
add_env_var "SENTRY_DSN" "https://c2d1ff9ae1f35e5f2f6fb254e6715558@o451087347639910.ingest.de.sentry.io/4510873522536528"

echo "✅ Environment variables added!"

EOF)
